Calling transfer (non-zero _to and sufficient balance) preserves totalSupply and moves the same amount from sender to recipient as observed by balances, i.e. sum of balances of sender and recipient decreases/increases by exactly _amount while totalSupply remains unchanged.
A successful transferFrom moves exactly _amount from _from to _to and leaves totalSupply unchanged; if it reverts, balances and totalSupply are unchanged.
